extracted.intended_audience: business journalists, editors, and newsrooms submitting work to the SABEW Best in Business Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and category definitions used by the Society for Advancing Business Editing and Writing (SABEW) to evaluate entries for the Best in Business Awards, focused on business and economic reporting across multiple beats and formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breaking News
rubrics_metrics.description: Business news as it happens

rubrics_metrics.name: Beat Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustained coverage of a business beat

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigative
rubrics_metrics.description: Uncovering corporate / financial wrongdoing

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanatory
rubrics_metrics.description: Making complex business concepts understandable

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature
rubrics_metrics.description: Feature (category listed without further elaboration on the page)

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Finance
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical impact on individual readers

rubrics_metrics.name: Real Estate
rubrics_metrics.description: Real estate coverage (category listed without further elaboration on the page)

rubrics_metrics.name: Markets / Investing
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage focused on markets and investing

rubrics_metrics.name: Health Care Business
rubrics_metrics.description: Business coverage in the health care sector

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Technology-sector business coverage

rubrics_metrics.name: Energy
rubrics_metrics.description: Energy-sector business coverage

rubrics_metrics.name: Banking / Finance
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage of banking and financial-sector matters

rubrics_metrics.name: Retail / Consumer
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage related to retail and consumer issues

rubrics_metrics.name: Workplace / Labor
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage of workplace and labor topics

rubrics_metrics.name: International Business
rubrics_metrics.description: Business reporting with an international scope

rubrics_metrics.name: Commentary / Editorial
rubrics_metrics.description: Opinion, commentary, or editorial work on business topics

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual Storytelling / Data Journalism
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of visuals and data-driven storytelling in business journalism

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation / Audience Engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Innovative approaches and audience engagement tactics in business journalism

rubrics_metrics.name: Market impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Effect on stocks, sectors, economy

rubrics_metrics.name: Consumer/worker impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Impact on consumers or workers (jobs, prices, retirement)

rubrics_metrics.name: Corporate accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage that addresses governance, fraud, ethics

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry trend significance
rubrics_metrics.description: Importance of the story to larger industry trends

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanatory clarity for non-specialists
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to make complex business concepts understandable to non-specialist readers

rubrics_metrics.name: Public policy intersections
rubrics_metrics.description: Connections between business reporting and public policy

rubrics_metrics.name: Numerical/financial rigor
rubrics_metrics.description: Accuracy and rigor in numerical and financial analysis

rubrics_metrics.name: Original sourcing and analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of original sources and proprietary analysis; originality in reporting

rubrics_metrics.name: Localized economic impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Economic impact at the local level
